about_us.title: About Shower Walls
about_us.subtitle: Leaders in innovative bathroom wall solutions.
about_us.heading: Built for the projects tile could not keep up with
about_us.description: At Shower Walls we manufacture and install high-performance shower wall panels, pans and accessories. We combine modern design, durability and innovation to renovate a bathroom without the noise, dust and delays of traditional remodeling.
about_us.description_secondary: Our systems were developed for hospitality, multifamily, student housing and healthcare operators who need hundreds of identical, flawless bathrooms delivered on a schedule — and for homeowners who want that same standard at home.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: To deliver modern, efficient alternatives to traditional tile, ensuring superior quality and seamless design on every unit we touch.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.text: To be the go-to brand for waterproof wall coverings in residential and commercial projects across North America.
